name: Camp Acorn at Somerset Hills YMCA
description_short: YMCA day camp at the Somerset Hills Y in Basking Ridge, 9 to 4, with swim lessons twice a week in the Y's indoor pools, sports, arts, science and a weekly bus trip. Groups run from preschool (ages 3 to 5, 9 to 2) and KinderCamp through grades 1 to 6, plus teen travel camp for grades 7 to 9 and a CIT program for grades 10 to 11.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund for cancellations before May 1, 2026; after that the Y keeps $50 per week per child, except for documented medical reasons. Fees are charged 14 days before each session.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer 2026: ten weeks, Monday June 22 to Friday August 28, for campers entering preschool to grade 11 in September 2026. Preschool camp ages 3 to 5, 9 to 2, first six weeks only; KinderCamp and grades 1 to 6 all ten weeks; Teen Travel Camp grades 7 to 9; CIT grades 10 to 11 in weeks 1 to 8. Camp hours 9 to 4, before care 7:30 to 9 and after care 4 to 6. Transportation is not provided; families pack lunch, pizza on Fridays only. No prices on the page or in the linked registration search (it showed 0 offerings). age_max 17 derived from grade 11, not stated. Phone is the Y's main number; camp emails are hidden on the page. Page also shows an 'American Camp Association Accredited' badge.
